Founded by Ali Hojat

MORE THAN
A RENTAL.
A FAMILY.

Ali Hojat started First Class Exotics in 2013 with nothing but a childhood obsession with Lamborghinis and an unshakeable belief that every client deserves to be treated like family. He was one of the first people in Southern California to build an exotic rental business from scratch — before it was trendy, before the influencers made it cool.

Over a decade later, the original vision has never changed. Every rental is personal. Every client gets Ali’s direct attention. Every car is sourced with care. Our exclusive partner network across OC and LA means we can deliver virtually any exotic on the market — and we are constantly adding new relationships to give you more options than anyone else.

We also believe in giving back. Annual toy drives, local nonprofit partnerships — because community is not a marketing word for us. It’s who we are.

Common Questions

GOT
QUESTIONS.

We answer every question honestly. No fine print games, no surprises. That’s what 10 years of family business looks like.

Still Have Questions? Ask Ali

You must be 25 or older with a valid driver’s license and full comprehensive & collision insurance in your name. A major credit card is required for the security deposit. Exemptions may be available — contact our team directly to discuss your situation.

Submit your request before noon and our family team will work to have your car delivered to any address in Orange County, Los Angeles, or San Diego that same day. We text you when we’re on the way. Hotel valets, driveways, offices — we come to you.

Our exclusive partner network across OC and LA means we can almost always find what you’re looking for. If your first choice is unavailable, we source an equal or better alternative at the same rate — always with your approval before we confirm.

Your existing full coverage personal auto insurance typically extends to rental vehicles, including exotic rentals. We recommend calling your agent before you book to verify. We do not require you to purchase additional coverage if your existing policy qualifies.

Absolutely. Multi-day, weekly, and monthly rentals receive significant discounts — typically 20–35% off the daily rate. Just mention your timeline in your booking request and our team will build you a custom package.

Simply mention code FIRSTCLASS in your booking notes. Our family team will verify and apply 10% off your first rental. This applies to all vehicles in our network. It’s our way of welcoming new clients to the First Class family.

Yes — this is one of our biggest advantages as a broker. We have relationships with the largest exotic fleet owners across Orange County and Los Angeles. G-Wagon, Corvette C8, Maybach, Aston Martin, Ferrari Roma, rare colorways, specialty builds — just ask and we’ll tell you what we can find.

We handle cancellations on a case-by-case basis because we are a family business, not a faceless corporation. Contact our team directly and we will work with you. We believe in treating every client fairly, and our track record of 5-star reviews reflects that.
